text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Symboli Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Symboli Kris S 
was gazing, I saw a claw crane machine 
filled with stuffed plushies modeled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...An Umamusume—is the model. Everyone is 
happy—that they got one.
choice_data_list: ぬいぐるみが気になるのか？
ぬいぐるみが気になるの？
choice_data_list_en: Did that plushie catch your eye?
Did that plushie catch your eye?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Popularity... It's tied to... bringing 
hype to the racing world.
choice_data_list: うん、かなり人気があるみたいだな
うん、かなり人気があるみたいだね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, looks like it's pretty popular.
Yeah, looks like you're pretty popular.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Symboli Kris S wants to know more 
about the plushies. In that case—
choice_data_list:
I'll give it a try and see if I can get 
it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: 取れないかチャレンジしてみるよ！
choice_data_list_en: I'll take the challenge and see if I can get it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
